additional_info.subject: RE: ID0394797-DC/Si-D/NZ -[oiCW7u] Retro fit revenue energy meter CRM:00796001076
additional_info.body:
Hey Kaushik,
No worries.
This was the original entry in the ticket –
“On the screen customers can see all their charging information on the screen how that data is not sent via the OCPP connection. Is it possible to retro fit revenue energy meter to provide this information?”
How I understand this is, the customer has a lot of info on the charger screen, but doesn’t have the same data over OCPP.
We know that chargers not fitted with DC meter, do not send energy.active.import.register, which is what the CPO uses to show ongoing energy in the charging session.
Thus I figured they wanted to have the DC meter fitted.
Additionally, via OCPP 1.6J and the California pricing model, the CPO is able to send pricing information to the SiCharge D screen, so if this is what the customer wants, then we would need to raise some integration between CPO and SiCharge D to undertake this.
With Kind Regards,
Ferdinand Reisch
Siemens Ltd.
Application Service Engineer
Phone: +61 499 701 794
Email: ferdinand.reisch@siemens.com
www.siemens.com.au/emobility
